about: Audit trail of the catalog corrections applied on branch claude/operating-standard-baseline-1 from docs/openloadout/FINDINGS.md section 1 and docs/openloadout/STANDARD.md (sections 4, 5.3, 10.3, Appendix A). One entry per correction per file and row. oldName null means the row was added; newName "removed" means it was deleted from that file (the default catalog's renamed and removed rows are archived for merged stores by archive-2026-09-28-baseline-0.1.json). No row was marked verified: confidence stays with the app's review workflow (DECISIONS 72-74). Entries with id PRIVACY replace personal names with a role (Baseline 0.1 rule 26); their old values are deliberately not repeated, and a store holding the old row renames it by hand.
